description: Prepare the canonical Agent Readiness declaration for one service and job: participants, endpoints, API and MCP interfaces, delegated authority, payment, recovery and library-job bindings. The company must already exist in Sourcey and resolves by exact identity; an unknown company returns identity_allocation_required. Complete declarations use POST /v1/submissions as product agent_readiness. Drafts grant no publication, verification or grade, and startup credits and deals never count as service readiness.
name: prepare_declaration
title: Prepare an Agent Readiness declaration
